## ע (id: BDB06708)

ע, ‘ *Ayin*, sixteenth letter; used as numeral 70 in postB. Heb.



## עבב (id: BDB06709)

עבב (√ of foll., cf. Köii. 1, 40; meaning unknown).

> \[Str5646] † I. עָב, \[עֹב] **n. m.** archit. term, meaning unknown; projecting roof is conjectured (Sm Co Berthol); others landing (Da); AV RV *thick beam* or *plank*, RVm *threshold;* Benz Kit Toy leave untranslated; in any case a structure of wood;—abs. וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב [1 K 7:6](https://ref.ly/1Kgs7:6); appar. cstr. וְעָב עֵץ אֶל־פְּנֵי הָאוּלָם מֵהַחוּץ Ez [41:25](https://ref.ly/Ezek41:25); pl. (si vera l.) הָעֻבִּים v:[26](https://ref.ly/Ezek41:26).

> \[Str5645] II. עָב v. עוּב

* **Associated Passages:** 1 Kings 7:6; Ezekiel 41:25; Ezekiel 41:26
* **Associated Articles:** עוב (ID: `BDB06842@BDBHebrewLexicon`)


## עָבַד (id: BDB06712)

\[Str5647] עָבַד:290 **vb.** work, serve (OAram. עבד *do make*, esp. Nab. Palm. (oft.), Lzb331 f. Cook86, so Targum עֲבַד, Syr. (very oft.); but also OAram. Ph. עבד *slave, vassal* (and in many n. pr.), Targum עַבְדָּא, Syr. ܥܰܒܕܳܐ *id.;* As. *abdu, id.* (rare); NH עָבַד *serve, performs acts of worship* (c. acc. cogn.), and deriv.; Ar. عَبَدَ *worship, obey* (God); cf. WeSkizzen iii. 165; Heid. 141, II. *enslave;* عَبْدٌ *slave, worshiper;* Sab. עבד *id.* DHMSüdar. Alt. p. 18; GerberVerb. ## עָבָה (id: BDB06730)

\[Str5666] † עָבָה **vb.** be thick, fat, gross (NH Pi. עִבָּה *make thick*, and deriv.; Syr. ܥܒܳܐ *swell up*, pt. pass. *swollen, thick, dense, stupid*, and many deriv.; Ar. غَبِىَ *be dense, stupid*, أَغُبَى *dense foliage;* Eth. ዐብየ፡ *be great* DI985);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 ms. מִמָּתְנֵי אָבִי ´קָֽטֳנִּי ע [1 K 12:10](https://ref.ly/1Kgs12:10) *my little finger is thicker* (stouter) than, etc., \= [2 Ch 10:10](https://ref.ly/2Chr10:10); *be thick, gross*, of rebell. Isr. under fig. of highly fed beast, 2 ms. שָׁמַנְתָּ עָבִיתָ כָּשִיתָ [Dt 32:15](https://ref.ly/Deut32:15).

> \[Str5672,5645] † עֲבִי **n.\[m.]** thickness;—cstr. נַּבֵּי מָגִנָּיו ´ע [Jb 15:26](https://ref.ly/Job15:26) *the thickness* (stoutness) *of the bosses* of his shields (in fig.); sf. עָבְיוֺ *its thickness*, of the molten sea [1 K 7:26](https://ref.ly/1Kgs7:26) \= [2 Ch 4:5](https://ref.ly/2Chr4:5); of pillar [Je 52:21](https://ref.ly/Jer52:21).—[2 Ch 4:17](https://ref.ly/2Chr4:17) v. foll.—Under עבה belongs perh. also בְּעַב הֶעָנָן [Ex 19:9](https://ref.ly/Exod19:9) (rd. בַּעֲבִי ?) in *the thickness* of the clouds, cf. BuTh Lz 1892 (3\), 63 Köii 1, 86\.

> \[Str4568] † מַעֲבֶה **n. \[m.]** si vera l., thickness, compactness;—בְּמַעֲבֵה הָאֲדָמָה [1 K 7:46](https://ref.ly/1Kgs7:46) *in the compactness of the soil*, i.e. *clayey ground* or *clay mould* \= [2 Ch 4:17](https://ref.ly/2Chr4:17) (where MT ´בַּעֲבִי הָ); but read doubtless in both בְּמַעְבֶּרֶת אֲדָמָה *at the ford of Adamah*, v. GFMJu 7, 22 BenzK.

> \[Str5688] עָבוֺת v. עבת

* **Associated Passages:** 2 Chronicles 4:17; 1 Kings 7:26; Deuteronomy 32:15; 1 Kings 7:46; Jeremiah 52:21; Exodus 19:9; Job 15:26; 1 Kings 12:10; 2 Chronicles 4:5; 2 Chronicles 10:10
* **Associated Articles:** עָבַת (ID: `BDB06761@BDBHebrewLexicon`)


## עבט (id: BDB06734)

עבט (perh. √ of foll.; cf. As. *ubbuṭu’* (II. of אבט \[\= עבט ?]) *be pledged* DlHWB 6; Aram. (Talm.) עֲבִיטָה *pledge*, עֲבַט Ithpe. *be taken in pledge;* but WeJo 2, 7 thinks עֲבוֺט Aram. loan\-word, and cp. Ar. ضَبَطَ *hold, keep, guard*).

> \[Str5667] † עֲבוֺט **n.\[m.]** pledge, article pledged as security for debt;—abs. ´ע [Dt 24:11](https://ref.ly/Deut24:11), [24:13](https://ref.ly/Deut24:13); sf. עֲבֹטוֺ v:[10](https://ref.ly/Deut24:10) (as acc. cogn.), v:[12](https://ref.ly/Deut24:12).

> \[Str5671] † עַבְטִיט **n.\[m.] intens.** weight of pledges, heavy debts;—abs. ´מַכְבִּיד עָלָיו ע Hb [2:6](https://ref.ly/Hab2:6).

> \[Str5670] † \[עָבַט] **vb. denom.** take or give a pledge;—**Qal** *Inf. cstr.* לַעֲבֹט [Dt 24:10](https://ref.ly/Deut24:10) *to take possession of a thing pledged* (c. acc. cogn.); *Impf.* 2 ms. *give a pledge* תַּעֲבֹט [Dt 15:6](https://ref.ly/Deut15:6) (i.e. *borrow*). **Hiph.** *Pf.* 2 ms. וְהַעֲבַטְתָּ֫ גּוֺיִם רַבִּים v:[6](https://ref.ly/Deut15:6) *and thou shalt cause many nations to give pledges* (i.e. lend to them); *Impf.* 3 ms. sf. \+ *Inf. abs.* הַעֲבֵט תַּעֲבִיטֶנּוּ v:[8](https://ref.ly/Deut15:8) *thou shalt surely lend to him* (lit. as above). **Pi.** *Impf.* יְעַבְּטוּן [Jo 2:7](https://ref.ly/Joel2:7) hardly makes sense (*lend on pledge* \= *interchange* ?); most rd. יְעַבְּתוּן; יְעַוְּתוּן We, cf. Now Dr GASm; Gr. יַטוּן.

* **Associated Passages:** Joel 2:7; Deuteronomy 24:11; Habakkuk 2:6; Deuteronomy 24:13; Deuteronomy 15:6; Deuteronomy 24:12; Deuteronomy 15:8; Deuteronomy 24:10


## עבל (id: BDB06738)

עבל (√ of foll.; cf. poss. Ar. عَبُلَ *be bulky, stout;* Pun. n. pr. עבל Lzb335).

> \[Str5658,5745] † עוֺבָל, I. עֵיבָל **n. pr. gent.** Arabian people, descended from Joktan acc. to [Gn 10:28](https://ref.ly/Gen10:28) (LXXL Γαιβαλ); \= עֵיבָל [1 Ch 1:22](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:22) (LXXL Ηβηλ). On loc. cf. GlaserSkizze ii. 426\.

> \[Str5658] I. עֵיבָל v. עוֺבָל supr.

> \[Str5658] † II. עֵיבָל **n. pr. m.** vel **gent.** name in Edom, [Gn 36:23](https://ref.ly/Gen36:23) (LXX Γαιβηλ), \= [1 Ch 1:40](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:40) (LXX Γαιβηλ), A Γαοβηλ LXXL Ουβαλ); acc. to GlaserSkizze ii. 426 poss. \= foregoing (cp. with name of (god) *Bēl*, WklGesch. Isr. 120; Alttest. Unters. 117 f.).

> \[Str5658] † III. עֵיבָל **n. pr. mont.** Ebal, the mt. of cursing, N. of Shechem (Nabulus), and opp. Mt. Gerizim (mt. of blessing, S. of Shechem), [Dt 11:29](https://ref.ly/Deut11:29), also [Jos 8:30](https://ref.ly/Josh8:30), [8:33](https://ref.ly/Josh8:33) (D); LXX Γαιβαλ (connex. with above √ dub.; on בל \= *Bēl*, cf. GrayProp. N. 124 n., and reff.);—on Ebal v. RobBR ii. 275 ff. GASmGeogr. Ch. vi. DIDt 11, 29 Drib. BDPal. (1898\), 257\.

* **Associated Passages:** 1 Chronicles 1:22; 1 Chronicles 1:40; Joshua 8:33; Genesis 10:28; Joshua 8:30; Genesis 36:23; Deuteronomy 11:29

(عدو) عَدَا *pass by*, also *run* \= Eth. ዐደወ፡ *pass by;* Aram. עדי *go along, go by* (oft. for Heb. עָבַר, Aph. *remove;* Syr. ܥܕܳܐ *pass by, come*, c. ܥܰܠ *fall upon*);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 ms. עָדָה [Jb 28:8](https://ref.ly/Job28:8) the fierce lion *hath not advanced* upon it (sc. the way). **Hiph.** *Pt.* מַעֲדֶה בֶּגֶד [Pr 25:20](https://ref.ly/Prov25:20) *removing a garment* (cf. 38:19 Targum, [Jon 3:6](https://ref.ly/Jonah3:6) Heb. and Targum).

III. עַד **II 3**); anger, לעד [Am 1:11](https://ref.ly/Amos1:11); elsewh. עֲדֵי עַד [Psalm 83:18](https://ref.ly/Ps83:18), [92:8](https://ref.ly/Ps92:8), [Is 26:4](https://ref.ly/Isa26:4), [65:18](https://ref.ly/Isa65:18). **d.** of divine existence, שֹׁכֵן עַד [Is 57:15](https://ref.ly/Isa57:15); attributes, לָעַד [Psalm 111:3](https://ref.ly/Ps111:3), [111:10](https://ref.ly/Ps111:10), [112:3](https://ref.ly/Ps112:3), [112:9](https://ref.ly/Ps112:9); residence in Zion, עֲדֵי עַד [132:14](https://ref.ly/Ps132:14); law of God לָעַד [19:10](https://ref.ly/Ps19:10); promise as to dynasty of David, לָעד [89:30](https://ref.ly/Ps89:30); עֲדֵי עַד [132:12](https://ref.ly/Ps132:12); inheritance of land, לָעַד [37:29](https://ref.ly/Ps37:29); continuous relations between God and his people [1 Ch 28:9](https://ref.ly/1Chr28:9), [Is 64:8](https://ref.ly/Isa64:8), [Mi 7:18](https://ref.ly/Mic7:18) לעד. **e.** phrases (see עולם **2 m**): וְֺלָם וָעֶָד(לְ) [Psalm 9:6](https://ref.ly/Ps9:6), [10:16](https://ref.ly/Ps10:16), [21:5](https://ref.ly/Ps21:5), [45:7](https://ref.ly/Ps45:7), [45:18](https://ref.ly/Ps45:18), [48:15](https://ref.ly/Ps48:15), [52:10](https://ref.ly/Ps52:10), [104:5](https://ref.ly/Ps104:5), [119:44](https://ref.ly/Ps119:44), [145:1](https://ref.ly/Ps145:1), [145:2](https://ref.ly/Ps145:2), [145:21](https://ref.ly/Ps145:21), [Ex 15:18](https://ref.ly/Exod15:18), [Mi 4:5](https://ref.ly/Mic4:5), [Dn 12:3](https://ref.ly/Dan12:3); לָעַד לְעוֺלָם [Psalm 111:8](https://ref.ly/Ps111:8), [148:6](https://ref.ly/Ps148:6); עַד־עוֺלְמֵי עַד [Is 45:17](https://ref.ly/Isa45:17).—[Is 30:8](https://ref.ly/Isa30:8) rd. (עַד־עוֺלָם) לְעֵד *for a witness* SyrVer Vulgate Targum Ges Ew Di Che Du) for MT לָעַד.

> \[Str5706] †II. עַד **n.\[m.]** booty, prey (upon which one *advances, falls*);—יאֹכַל עַד [Gn 49:27](https://ref.ly/Gen49:27) *devour prey* (‖שָׁלָל); עַד שָׁלָל מַרְבֶּה [Is 33:23](https://ref.ly/Isa33:23) *prey of great spoil*; קוּמִי לְעַד [Zp 3:8](https://ref.ly/Zeph3:8) (of God) my *rising up to the prey* (BrMp); אֲבִי עַד [Is 9:5](https://ref.ly/Isa9:5) *father* i.e. *distributor) of booty* (Hi Kn Kue BrMp Du CheHpt; \> Ges Ew Di al. *everlasting father*).

> \[Str5704] III. עַד, in poetry עֲדֵי († [Nu 24:20](https://ref.ly/Num24:20), [24:24](https://ref.ly/Num24:24), [Psalm 104:23](https://ref.ly/Ps104:23), [147:6](https://ref.ly/Ps147:6), [Jb 7:4](https://ref.ly/Job7:4), [20:5](https://ref.ly/Job20:5), and in עֲדֵי עַד [Is 26:4](https://ref.ly/Isa26:4), [65:18](https://ref.ly/Isa65:18), [Psalm 83:18](https://ref.ly/Ps83:18), [92:8](https://ref.ly/Ps92:8), [132:12](https://ref.ly/Ps132:12), [132:14](https://ref.ly/Ps132:14):cf. אֱלֵי, עֲלֵי), **prep.** as far as, even to, up to, until, while (Aram. עד, ܥܕ Sab. עד, עדי, MordtmZMG xxx (1876\), 27; DHMxxxvii (1883\), 414, As. *adi* Dl:§ 81 a (Ar. عَدَا is *except*); perh akin to عَدَا *pass on, advance to*, Köii. 304, 309: עֲדֵי prob. from ground\-form *‘ădăy*, Ol428, 431 Köii. 309 ff.; but LagSym. ii. 101–3, Mitth. i. 231 f., as plur. like אַחֲרֵי);—with sf. עָדַי [Nu 23:18](https://ref.ly/Num23:18) \+, עָדֶיְ [Mi 4:8](https://ref.ly/Mic4:8) \+, etc., עָֽדיֵכֵם † [Jb 32:12](https://ref.ly/Job32:12); [2 K 9:18](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:18) עַד־הֵם occurs;—*as far as, even* to (differing from אֶל in that the limit is included, as in Ar. حَتَّى FlKl. Schr. i. 402 f.): **I. prep.1** of *space*;—**a.** [Gn 11:31](https://ref.ly/Gen11:31) ויבאו עד חרן *as far as* Haran, [12:6](https://ref.ly/Gen12:6), [13:3](https://ref.ly/Gen13:3), [13:12](https://ref.ly/Gen13:12) \+ oft., [Is 8:8](https://ref.ly/Isa8:8) עד צואר יגעַ, [15:4](https://ref.ly/Isa15:4) עד יהץ נשׁמע קולם, [25:12](https://ref.ly/Isa25:12), [26:5](https://ref.ly/Isa26:5), [Psalm 36:6](https://ref.ly/Ps36:6) אמונתך עד שׁחקים, [69:2](https://ref.ly/Ps69:2) דאו מים עד נפשׁ (cf. > **b.** In the combin. עַד(וְ) …מִן, as [Gn 10:19](https://ref.ly/Gen10:19) עַד עַזָּה …מצידון *from* Sidon…*as far as* Gaza \+ oft. (v. מן **5 a**); and idiom., not of actual space, but of *class of objects*, to express the idea of *both... and*, as [Gn 19:4](https://ref.ly/Gen19:4) מִנַּעַר וְעַד זָקִן *from* young *to* old (inclusively) \= *both* young *and* old (v. מִן **5 b**); without מִן, *even to* \= *including*, [Lv 11:42](https://ref.ly/Lev11:42), [Nu 8:4](https://ref.ly/Num8:4) *even to* (i. e. including) it base and its flower, cf. [1 S 18:4](https://ref.ly/1Sam18:4). **2\.** Of *time:* **a.** *(a) even to, until* [Gn 8:5](https://ref.ly/Gen8:5) *even to* the 10th month, Ex [12:6](https://ref.ly/Exod12:6) *unto* the 14th day, etc., v:[15](https://ref.ly/Exod12:15), v:[18](https://ref.ly/Exod12:18), etc.; עד היום *unto this day*, [Gn 19:37](https://ref.ly/Gen19:37), [19:38](https://ref.ly/Gen19:38), עד היום הזה [26:33](https://ref.ly/Gen26:33), [32:33](https://ref.ly/Gen32:32), both \+ oft.; עד יום sq. inf. [Ex 40:37](https://ref.ly/Exod40:37), [Jos 6:10](https://ref.ly/Josh6:10), Ju [18:30](https://ref.ly/Judg18:30); עד בקר *till* morning, [Ex 12:10](https://ref.ly/Exod12:10) \+ (15 t.), עד הבקר [16:23](https://ref.ly/Exod16:23) \+ (11 t.); so ערב(ה)עד [Ex 18:13](https://ref.ly/Exod18:13), [18:14](https://ref.ly/Exod18:14) \+, poet. עֲרֵי ערב [Psalm 104:23](https://ref.ly/Ps104:23); עַד עוֺלָם [Gn 13:15](https://ref.ly/Gen13:15) \+ oft.; עַד שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים [2 K 4:35](https://ref.ly/2Kgs4:35); עַד דּוֺר וָדוֺר [Is 13:20](https://ref.ly/Isa13:20); v. also בְּלִי, and בִּלְתִּי, *ad fin.* And sq. another prep., [Lv 23:16](https://ref.ly/Lev23:16) עַד מִמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת, [Ne 13:9](https://ref.ly/Neh13:9) עַד אַחַר הַשַּׁבָּת. With the force of *against*, Ju [6:31](https://ref.ly/Judg6:31) יוּמַת עַד הַבֹּקֶר; cf. *(b) end.* *(b)* sq. inf., both of past time, as [Gn 8:7](https://ref.ly/Gen8:7), 32:35 עַד עֲלוֺת הַשַּׁחַר, [33:3](https://ref.ly/Gen33:3), [34:5](https://ref.ly/Gen34:5), and esp. future time, as [3:19](https://ref.ly/Gen3:19) עַד שׁוּבְ *until* thy returning, [19:22](https://ref.ly/Gen19:22), [27:45](https://ref.ly/Gen27:45), [Dt 7:20](https://ref.ly/Deut7:20), [7:23](https://ref.ly/Deut7:23), [20:20](https://ref.ly/Deut20:20), [22:2](https://ref.ly/Deut22:2), [28:20](https://ref.ly/Deut28:20), [28:22](https://ref.ly/Deut28:22), —both \+ oft.; cf. עַד בּוֺשׁ Ju [3:25](https://ref.ly/Judg3:25) \+; …עַד תֹּם [Lv 25:29](https://ref.ly/Lev25:29) \+ 10 t.; עַד תֻּמָּם [Dt 2:15](https://ref.ly/Deut2:15) \+; עַד כַּלֵּה † [2 K 13:17](https://ref.ly/2Kgs13:17), [13:19](https://ref.ly/2Kgs13:19), Ezr 19:14; (ם)עַד כַּלּוֺתָ [1 S 15:18](https://ref.ly/1Sam15:18), [Je 9:15](https://ref.ly/Jer9:15) \+; עַד אוֺר הַבֹּקֶר Ju [16:2](https://ref.ly/Judg16:2) \+; also in עַד הִשְׁמִדְ אֹתָם [Dt 7:24](https://ref.ly/Deut7:24) (cf. [28:48](https://ref.ly/Deut28:48) [Jos 11:14](https://ref.ly/Josh11:14), [1 K 15:29](https://ref.ly/1Kgs15:29), [2 K 3:25](https://ref.ly/2Kgs3:25), [10:17](https://ref.ly/2Kgs10:17), [24:20](https://ref.ly/2Kgs24:20) \[‖ [Je 52:3](https://ref.ly/Jer52:3) הִשְׁלִיכוֺ]; on the anom. ´הִ, v. Dr, rd. prob. ´הַ); and most prob. cf. Köiii. 583\) in שָרִיד (לָהֶם)עַד בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר לוֺ [Dt. 3:3](https://ref.ly/Deut3:3) (v. Dr), \+ 5 t. (v. supr. p. 117\), rd. prob. הַשְׁאִיר. With the force of *towards the end of, against*, esp. in (ם)עַד בֹּאָ, [Gn 43:25](https://ref.ly/Gen43:25), [Ex 22:25](https://ref.ly/Exod22:25), [Nu 10:21](https://ref.ly/Num10:21) והקימו את המשׁכן עַד בֹּאָם used to set up the tab. *against* their coming, [2 K 16:11](https://ref.ly/2Kgs16:11), Ez [33:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek33:22); cf. [2 S 17:22](https://ref.ly/2Sam17:22). Ellipt. Ju [16:2](https://ref.ly/Judg16:2) עַד אוֺד הַבֹּקֶד וַהֲרַגְנוּהוּ (wait) *till* the morning dawn, and we slay him! (GFM; Dr§ 115\). (c) with various adverbs of time. (q.v.) as עַד אָנָה, עַד־מָה, עַד מָתַי, עַד הֵנָּה, עַד כֹּה, עַד כֵּן, עַד עַתָּה, cf. עַד כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים (v. מָה **4 b**). (*d*) to suffest also *degree* (cf. **3**), עַד אֵין מָקוֺם *until* there is no place [Is 5:8](https://ref.ly/Isa5:8), עַד אֵין מִסְפָּר † [Psalm 40:13](https://ref.ly/Ps40:13), [Jb 5:9](https://ref.ly/Job5:9), [9:10](https://ref.ly/Job9:10); cf. [Lv 26:18](https://ref.ly/Lev26:18) וְאִם־עַד־אֵלֶּה and if *even up to these things*, even the end of all these punishment, you do not hearken to me. **b.** *During* (rare; prop, *as far as* the limit indicated, including the time previous, cf. ἔως: so oft. Aram. עַד, ܥܕ, *while*), [2 K 9:22](https://ref.ly/2Kgs9:22) what is peace עַד זְנוּנֵי אִיזֶבֶל *during*, etc.,? [Jb 20:5](https://ref.ly/Job20:5) עֲדֵי רָגַע *during* a moment; sq. inf. Ju [3:26](https://ref.ly/Judg3:26) עַד הִתְמַהְמְהָם *during* their delaying, [Ex 33:22](https://ref.ly/Exod33:22), [Jb 7:19](https://ref.ly/Job7:19) עַד בִּלְעִי רֻקִּי [Jon 4:2](https://ref.ly/Jonah4:2). **3\.** Of *degree*, to suggest a higher or the highest; as עַד מְאֹד *even to* muchness, i.e. exceedingly (v. מְאֹד), עַד מְהֵרָה *even to haste* † [Psalm 147:15](https://ref.ly/Ps147:15); [Est 5:6](https://ref.ly/Esth5:6) וּמַה־בֻּקָּשָׁתֵךְ עַד־חֲצִי הַמַּלְכוּת וְתֵעָש, v:[3](https://ref.ly/Esth5:3); [7:2](https://ref.ly/Esth7:2). See also עַד לְ, below. With a neg., to express *not even as much as*, [Dt 2:5](https://ref.ly/Deut2:5) לא אתן לכם מארצם עַד מִדְרַךְ כַּף רָגֶל, and with אֶחָד, † [Ex 9:7](https://ref.ly/Exod9:7) עַד־אֶחָד …לאֹ מֵת, simil. [14:28](https://ref.ly/Exod14:28), Ju [4:16](https://ref.ly/Judg4:16), [2 S 17:22](https://ref.ly/2Sam17:22) (rd. אֶחָד for אַחַד: v. Dr). Sts. almost \= Lat. *adeo*, [1 S 2:5](https://ref.ly/1Sam2:5) (si vera l.) עַד עֲקָרָה ילדה שׁבעה *even to* the barren, she hath borne seven, i.e. *even* the barren hath, etc., [Jb 25:5](https://ref.ly/Job25:5) הן עד־יָרֵחַ ולא יאהיל, [Hg 2:19](https://ref.ly/Hag2:19). In comparisons, *to the degree of, even like* (rare), [Na 1:10](https://ref.ly/Nah1:10) עַד סִירִים סְבֻכִים (text dub.) entangled *even like* thorns, [1 Ch 4:27](https://ref.ly/1Chr4:27) לא הִרְבּוּ עד בני יהודה did not multiply *to the degree of* (i.e.*like*), etc. Cf.. [2 S 23:19](https://ref.ly/2Sam23:19) עַד הַשְּׁלשָׁה לאֹ בָא did not *attain* (in prowess) *unto* the three. **II. Conj. 1\.** *until*;—**a** עַד אֲשֶׁר *until that: (a)* with pf., of *past time*, [Ex 32:20](https://ref.ly/Exod32:20) ויטחן עד אשׁר דָּק ([Dt 9:21](https://ref.ly/Deut9:21)), [Dt 2:14](https://ref.ly/Deut2:14) עד אשׁר עָבַרְנוּ, [Jos 3:17](https://ref.ly/Josh3:17), [8:26](https://ref.ly/Josh8:26), Ju [4:24](https://ref.ly/Judg4:24), [1 K 10:7](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:7) ([2 Ch 9:6](https://ref.ly/2Chr9:6)), [2 K 17:20](https://ref.ly/2Kgs17:20), [17:23](https://ref.ly/2Kgs17:23), [21:16](https://ref.ly/2Kgs21:16); with suggestion of *degree*, [1 S 30:4](https://ref.ly/1Sam30:4) (sq. אֵין), [1 K 17:17](https://ref.ly/1Kgs17:17); rarely of *future* time (the ‘future perfect,’ Dr§ 17\), [2 S 17:13](https://ref.ly/2Sam17:13) (of degree), Ez [34:21](https://ref.ly/Ezek34:21) So \-עַד שֶׁ (oft. in NH; v. שֶׁ) † Ju [5:7](https://ref.ly/Judg5:7), Ct [3:4](https://ref.ly/Song3:4), [3:4](https://ref.ly/Song3:4); עַד כִּי † [Gn 26:13](https://ref.ly/Gen26:13) עַד כִּי־גָדַל מְאֹד, [41:49](https://ref.ly/Gen41:49), [2 S 23:10](https://ref.ly/2Sam23:10), [2 Ch 26:15](https://ref.ly/2Chr26:15); and (of future time) עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם † [Gn 28:15](https://ref.ly/Gen28:15), [Nu 32:17](https://ref.ly/Num32:17), [Is 6:11](https://ref.ly/Isa6:11). (*b*) with impf., usu. of *future* time, [Gn 27:44](https://ref.ly/Gen27:44) עַד אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁוּב חֲמַר אָחִיְ, [29:8](https://ref.ly/Gen29:8), [Ex 23:30](https://ref.ly/Exod23:30), [24:14](https://ref.ly/Exod24:14), [Lv 22:4](https://ref.ly/Lev22:4), [Nu 11:20](https://ref.ly/Num11:20), [20:17](https://ref.ly/Num20:17), [1 S 22:3](https://ref.ly/1Sam22:3), [Ho 5:15](https://ref.ly/Hos5:15) \+; rarely of *past* time, [Jon 4:5](https://ref.ly/Jonah4:5) עד אשׁר יראה *till he should* see, [Ec 2:3](https://ref.ly/Eccl2:3). B. In poetry, עַד is sts. used to mark not an absolute close, but an epoch or turning\-point, in the fut., as [Psalm 110:1](https://ref.ly/Ps110:1) (v. De) עַד אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיְ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיְ, [Ho 10:12](https://ref.ly/Hos10:12), [Jb 14:6](https://ref.ly/Job14:6) (but v. **3**); after a neg. cl., [Gn 49:10](https://ref.ly/Gen49:10), [Nu 23:24](https://ref.ly/Num23:24), [Is 42:4](https://ref.ly/Isa42:4), [Psalm 71:18](https://ref.ly/Ps71:18), [112:8](https://ref.ly/Ps112:8), [Jb 8:21](https://ref.ly/Job8:21) (but rd. prob. with Ew Hi Di Du *al.* עֹד he will *yet*, etc., understanding v:[20](https://ref.ly/Job8:20) as present, not future). **2\.** *While* (rare: cf. 12 b):—**a.** with pf., [1 S 14:19](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:19) עד דִּבֶּר שׁאול *while* Saul spake. **b.** with impf., [Psalm 141:10](https://ref.ly/Ps141:10) יַחד אָנֹכִי עַד אֶעֱבֹר *while I* at the same time pass by. **c.** with ptcp., [Jb 1:18](https://ref.ly/Job1:18) עַד זֶה מְדַבֵּר (but rd. prob. עֹד, as v:[16](https://ref.ly/Job1:16), v:[17](https://ref.ly/Job1:17)), [Ne 7:3](https://ref.ly/Neh7:3). **d.** \-עַד שֶׁ (without vb.) † Ct [1:12](https://ref.ly/Song1:12). So עַד לאֹ *while not \= ere yet* (of past time) † [Pr 8:26](https://ref.ly/Prov8:26) עד לא עשה אדץ (so עַד לָא, ܠܴܐ ܥܰܕ, oft., e.g. [Gn 24:15](https://ref.ly/Gen24:15) Targum, [Mt 1:18](https://ref.ly/Matt1:18)); and עד אשׁר לא (of the fut.) † [Ec 12:1](https://ref.ly/Eccl12:1), [12:2](https://ref.ly/Eccl12:2), [12:6](https://ref.ly/Eccl12:6) (cf. Talm. עַד דְּלָא, Mishn. שֶׁלּאֹ עַד). **3\.** Of degree, *to the point that, so that even* (rare), [Is 47:7](https://ref.ly/Isa47:7) Thou saidst, I shall be for ever a lady, עַד לאֹ שַמְתְּ אֵלֶּה עַל לִבֵךְ *to the point that* (going so far in thy pride that) thou didst not, etc. (but Hi Che Du *al.* join גְּבֶרֶת עַד I shall be for ever, a lady *perpetually;* v. 1\. עַד); [Jb 14:6](https://ref.ly/Job14:6) (Di De Bu Du ) *to the point that* he may enjoy, etc., [Is 22:14](https://ref.ly/Isa22:14) (Du). In [Jos 17:14](https://ref.ly/Josh17:14) עַד אֲשֶׁר ´עַד כֹּה בֵּֽרְכַנִי י, rd. עַל אֲשֶׁר *because* that (Ges Buhl; cf. Di). † **III.** עַד לְ, a strengthened form for עַד, found chiefly in Ch Ezr, and occurring in most of the above senses. ## II עָדָה (id: BDB06796)

\[Str5710] †II. עָדָה **vb.** ornament, deck oneself (Aram. in deriv. עִידּוּת, *ornament;* cf. perh. עֲדִיתָא, *scurf, scab;* Ar. عَدْوَى *mange, scab,* etc. \[as sheathing, or excrescence ?], also عِدَني, *broad stone* for covering grave, etc., Lane1979);—**Qal** *Pf.* 2 fs. וְעָדִית Ez [23:40](https://ref.ly/Ezek23:40); *Impf.* 3 fs. תַּעְדֶּה [Is 61:10](https://ref.ly/Isa61:10), וַתַּ֫עַד [Ho 2:15](https://ref.ly/Hos2:15); 2 fs. תַּעְדִּי [Je 4:30](https://ref.ly/Jer4:30), [31:4](https://ref.ly/Jer31:4), וַתַּעְדִּי Ez [16:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:13); 1 S. sf. וָאֶעְדֵךְ v:[11](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:11); *Imv.* ms. עֲדֵה־נָא [Jb 40:10](https://ref.ly/Job40:10); —*ornament;* usu. **1\. a.** reflex., *deck oneself* with, c. acc. of (woman's) ornaments, of bride [Is 61:10](https://ref.ly/Isa61:10) (sim.; cf. הִלְבִּישׁ va); fig. of Isr. [Ho 2:15](https://ref.ly/Hos2:15), [Je 31:4](https://ref.ly/Jer31:4); Jerus. [Je 4:30](https://ref.ly/Jer4:30) (c. acc. cogn,; ‖לָבַשׁ), Ez [16:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:13) (מַלְבּוּשֵׁךְ in ‖ clause), [23:40](https://ref.ly/Ezek23:40) (c. acc. cogn.). **b.** metaph., עֲדֵה־נָא גָאוֺן וגוי [Jb 40:10](https://ref.ly/Job40:10) *deck now thyself* \[Job] *with majesty*. **2\.** c. 2\. acc., וָאֶעְדֵךְ עֶָדִי Ez [16:11](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:11) *and I decked thee* \[Jerus.] *with finery* (? rd. **Hiph.** ´וָאַ).

## I עָוָה (id: BDB06860)

\[Str5753] † I. \[עָוָה] **vb.** bend, twist (so Ar. عَوَى);—**Niph.** *Pf.* 1 S. נַעֲוֵיתִי [Is 21:3](https://ref.ly/Isa21:3), [Psalm 38:7](https://ref.ly/Ps38:7); *Pt.* cstr. נַעֲוֵה [Pr 12:8](https://ref.ly/Prov12:8); f. cstr. נַעֲוַת [1 S 20:30](https://ref.ly/1Sam20:30) (but rd. נַעֲרַת LXX We Dr SS Bu HPS);—*be bent, bowed down, twisted*, ‖שׁחה [Psalm 38:7](https://ref.ly/Ps38:7); ‖נבהל [Is 21:3](https://ref.ly/Isa21:3); נַעֲוֵה לֵב [Pr 12:8](https://ref.ly/Prov12:8) *one perverted of mind*. **Pi.** *Pf.* 3 ms. עִוָּה, subj. ´י:—[La 3:9](https://ref.ly/Lam3:9) my paths *hath he twisted;* ´וְע [Is 24:1](https://ref.ly/Isa24:1) *its surface will he distort* (‖בּוֺקֵק הָאָרֶץ). **Hiph.** *Pf.* 1 S. יָשָׁר הֶעֱוֵיתִי [Jb 33:27](https://ref.ly/Job33:27) *the right have I perverted* (‖חָטָא); so 3 pl. הֶעֱווּ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם [Je 3:21](https://ref.ly/Jer3:21).

> \[Str5754] † I. עַוָּה **n. f.** distortion, ruin;—עַוָּה עַוָּה עַוָּה אֲשִימֶנָּה Ez [21:32](https://ref.ly/Ezek21:32) (cf. √ **Pi.** [Is 24:1](https://ref.ly/Isa24:1)).

> \[Str5773] † עִוְעִים **n. pl. abstr.** distorting, warping (for …עַוְעֲוִים);—רוּחַ עִוְעִים [Is 19:14](https://ref.ly/Isa19:14) *temper of distorting*, i.e. *warped* judgment.

> \[Str5856,1164] † עִי **n.\[m.]** ruin, heap of ruins;—´ע abs. [Jb 30:24](https://ref.ly/Job30:24), cstr. [Mi 1:6](https://ref.ly/Mic1:6); pl. עִיִּין (Aram. form) [3:12](https://ref.ly/Mic3:12), but עִיִּים in the quotation [Je 26:18](https://ref.ly/Jer26:18), and [Psalm 79:1](https://ref.ly/Ps79:1).

> \[Str4596] † מְעִי **n.\[m.]** ruin (si vera 1\.);—וְהָֽיְתָה מְעִי מַפָּלָה consec. [Is 17:1](https://ref.ly/Isa17:1) *Damascus shall become a ruinous heap* (but del. ´מ LXX Lag Che SS Buhl). cf p. 590

Nithp.; Aram. עַוֵּית Pa.; cf. ܥܰܬ, ܥܬܳܐ *deceive* PS3008);—**Pi.** *Pf.* 3 ms. sf. עִוְּתָנִי [Jb 19:6](https://ref.ly/Job19:6), עִוְּתוֺ [Ec 7:13](https://ref.ly/Eccl7:13); 3 pl. sf. עִוְּתוּנִי [Psalm 119:78](https://ref.ly/Ps119:78); *Impf.* 3 ms. יְעַוֵּת [Psalm 146:9](https://ref.ly/Ps146:9), [Jb 8:3](https://ref.ly/Job8:3), יְעַוֶּ־ת v:[3](https://ref.ly/Job8:3); *Inf.* לְעַוֵּת [Am 8:5](https://ref.ly/Amos8:5), [La 3:22](https://ref.ly/Lam3:22); —**1\. a.** *make crooked* \= falsify, scales [Am 8:5](https://ref.ly/Amos8:5); *pervert* justice (מִשְׁפָּט, צֶדֶק) [Jb 8:3](https://ref.ly/Job8:3), [8:3](https://ref.ly/Job8:3), [34:12](https://ref.ly/Job34:12) (all God subj.); c. acc. Pers. *subvert* (i.e. deprive of justice), אָדָם בְּרִיבוֺ ´לְע [La 3:36](https://ref.ly/Lam3:36), cf. [Psalm 119:78](https://ref.ly/Ps119:78); so עִוְּתָנִי [Jb 19:6](https://ref.ly/Job19:6) (´י subj.). **2\.** *bend, make crooked*, דֶּרֶח רְשָׁעִים [Psalm 146:9](https://ref.ly/Ps146:9) (´י subj.); in gen. [Ec 7:13](https://ref.ly/Eccl7:13) (God subj.; opp. תִּקֵּן). **Pu.** *Pt.* מְעֻוָּת [Ec 1:15](https://ref.ly/Eccl1:15) *what is bent* (opp. תְּקֹן). **Hithp.** *Pf.* 3 pl. consec. וְהִתְעַוְּתוּ [Ec 12:3](https://ref.ly/Eccl12:3) *and* the strong men *bend themselves*.

> \[Str5792] † \[עַוָּתָה] **n. f.** subversion, i.e. deprivation of justice;—sf. עַוָּתָתִי [La 3:59](https://ref.ly/Lam3:59) (opp. מִשְׁפָּטִי).

* **Associated Passages:** Psalms 119:78; Lamentations 3:22; Ecclesiastes 1:15; Ecclesiastes 12:3; Job 19:6; Job 8:3; Psalms 146:9; Amos 8:5; Job 34:12; Lamentations 3:36; Lamentations 3:59; Ecclesiastes 7:13

[Gn 42:37](https://ref.ly/Gen42:37), [2 K 12:12](https://ref.ly/2Kgs12:12), [22:5](https://ref.ly/2Kgs22:5), cf. 1 K [14:27](https://ref.ly/1Kgs14:27), עזב [Psalm 10:14](https://ref.ly/Ps10:14), גלל [37:5](https://ref.ly/Ps37:5), השׁליך [55:23](https://ref.ly/Ps55:23), פקד [Jb 34:13](https://ref.ly/Job34:13) al.; [Gn 30:28](https://ref.ly/Gen30:28) נָקְבָה שְכָֽרְ עָלַי fix thy wages *upon* me (*name* thy wages *to* me), [34:12](https://ref.ly/Gen34:12) הַרְבּוּ עָלַי מְאֹד מֹהַר וּמַתָּו multiply *upon* me, etc., [2 S 19:39](https://ref.ly/2Sam19:39) (pregn.) whatsoever thou choosest (and layest) *upon* me; without a verb, Ju [19:20](https://ref.ly/Judg19:20) רַק כָּל־מַחְסֹערְ עָלָי only let all thy wants be *upon* me, [Ezr 10:4](https://ref.ly/Ezra10:4), [Psalm 56:13](https://ref.ly/Ps56:13) עָלַי נְדָרֶיְ thy vows are *upon* me (i.e. I owe them: cf. [Zc 12:2](https://ref.ly/Zech12:2) (Ew RVm); [Nu 7:9](https://ref.ly/Num7:9) (P) the service of ... was *upon* them, Ez [45:17](https://ref.ly/Ezek45:17), so especially late [1 Ch 9:27](https://ref.ly/1Chr9:27), [9:33](https://ref.ly/1Chr9:33), [23:31](https://ref.ly/1Chr23:31), [2 Ch 2:3](https://ref.ly/2Chr2:3) לעולם זאת על ישראל [8:15](https://ref.ly/2Chr8:15), [24:9](https://ref.ly/2Chr24:9), [Ezr 7:11](https://ref.ly/Ezra7:11), [Ne 11:23](https://ref.ly/Neh11:23); [Is 9:5](https://ref.ly/Isa9:5) and the government is *upon,* his shoulder (cf. [22:22](https://ref.ly/Isa22:22)), [2 Ch 25:3](https://ref.ly/2Chr25:3); [Psalm 7:11](https://ref.ly/Ps7:11) ´מָֽגִנִּי עַל־א my shield rests *upon* God (he has undertaken my defence), [62:8](https://ref.ly/Ps62:8) על־אלהים יִשְׁעִי וּכְבֹדִי. **d.** על is used idiom. to give pathos to the expression of an emotion, by emphasizing the person who is its subject, and who, as it were, feels it acting *upon* him: [Psalm 42:6](https://ref.ly/Ps42:6) why art thou cast down, O my soul, וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלַי and disquieted *upon me*? v:[7](https://ref.ly/Ps42:7) my soul *upon me* is cast down, v:[12](https://ref.ly/Ps42:11), [43:5](https://ref.ly/Ps43:5), [La 3:20](https://ref.ly/Lam3:20); [Psalm 131:2](https://ref.ly/Ps131:2) כְּגָמֻל עֲלֵי אִמּוֺ כַּגָּמוּל עָלַי נַפְשִׁי is my soul *upon me;* [142:4](https://ref.ly/Ps142:4) בְּהִתְעַטֵף עָלַי רוּחִי when my spirit faints *upon me*, [143:4](https://ref.ly/Ps143:4), [Jon 2:8](https://ref.ly/Jonah2:8); [Je 8:18](https://ref.ly/Jer8:18) :עָלַי לִבִּי דַרוָּֽי my heart *upon me* is sick, [Jb 14:22](https://ref.ly/Job14:22), [14:22](https://ref.ly/Job14:22) (cf. Di), [Hos 11:8](https://ref.ly/Hos11:8) נהפך עלי לבי my heart is turned (altered) *upon me*, [1 S 17:32](https://ref.ly/1Sam17:32), [25:36](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:36), [Ne 5:7](https://ref.ly/Neh5:7) וַיִמָּלֵךְ לִבִּי עָלַי and my heart took counsel *upon me:* cf. [Psalm 42:5](https://ref.ly/Ps42:5) I will pour out my soul *upon me*, [Jb 30:16](https://ref.ly/Job30:16); [10:1](https://ref.ly/Job10:1) אעזבה עלי שיחי I will let loose my complaint *upon me*. (Thes *apud me, mecum*. The rend. ‘*within me*’ alters entirely the point of view of the Heb. expression, and is incorrect.) Denoting with some emph. the subj. of an experience, [Jb 30:2](https://ref.ly/Job30:2) עלימו אבד כָּלַךְ, [Dn 2:1](https://ref.ly/Dan2:1) his sleep נִהְיְתָה עָלָיו was done with *upon* him (cf. Aram. [6:19](https://ref.ly/Dan6:19) נַדַּת עֲלוֺהִי), [10:8](https://ref.ly/Dan10:8) וְהוֺדִי נֶהְפַּךְ עָלַי (cf. [5:9](https://ref.ly/Dan5:9), [7:28](https://ref.ly/Dan7:28)): also, rather differently, [Lv 18:18](https://ref.ly/Lev18:18) b, [Je 49:20](https://ref.ly/Jer49:20) אִם לאֹ יַשִׁים עֲלֵיהֶם נְוֵהֶם, [Mi 7:13](https://ref.ly/Mic7:13), [Psalm 90:17](https://ref.ly/Ps90:17) b; [Psalm 7:9](https://ref.ly/Ps7:9) acc. to my perfectness *upon* me, Ez [18:20](https://ref.ly/Ezek18:20); [22:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek22:3), [2 Ch 36:8](https://ref.ly/2Chr36:8). **e.** חָיָה עַל to live *upon* (as upon a foundation or support; cf. [Is 3:1](https://ref.ly/Isa3:1), and Ζῆν ἐπί τινος), [Dt 8:3](https://ref.ly/Deut8:3) עַל־הַלֶּחֶם, [Is 38:16](https://ref.ly/Isa38:16) (cf. Hi), [Gn 27:40](https://ref.ly/Gen27:40) על חרבך תחיה *upon* ( \= *by*) thy sword thou shalt live (cf. Kazwiniii. 17 *ap.* Tuch), Ez [33:19](https://ref.ly/Ezek33:19), cf. v:[26](https://ref.ly/Ezek33:26). **f.** Of the *ground,* or *basis, on* which a thing is done, as [Gn 24:9](https://ref.ly/Gen24:9) על הדבר הזה, [Lv 17:12](https://ref.ly/Lev17:12) if he offers it עַל תּוֺדָה *on the ground of* a thanks\-giving, [Nu 6:21](https://ref.ly/Num6:21) עַל נִזְרוֺ, vb Ez [16:15](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:15), [28:17](https://ref.ly/Ezek28:17), [Dn 8:25](https://ref.ly/Dan8:25) עַל שִכְלוֺ, [9:18](https://ref.ly/Dan9:18) עַל צדקותינו, (with عَلَي this use is extended so as to denote explicitly *on condition of*). Hence (*a*) the basis being conceived as *regulative*, על comes to denote the *norm* or *standard* (cf. Germ. ‘*auf* die Art’ WAG ii. § 59 i): the transition may be seen in a passage like [Ex 24:8](https://ref.ly/Exod24:8) the covenant which ´י made with you *on the basis of* (על), or *in agreement with,* all these words (cf. על פי [34:27](https://ref.ly/Exod34:27)), [Nu 35:24](https://ref.ly/Num35:24) האלה על המשׁפטים, [Dt 17:11](https://ref.ly/Deut17:11), [Je 30:18](https://ref.ly/Jer30:18) the palace shall sit (i.e. be inhabited: v. ישׁב) עַל מִשְׁפָּטוֺ *in accordance with* its manner, [Psalm 94:20](https://ref.ly/Ps94:20) who frames mischief עֲלֵי־חֹק *in accordance with* a law, ... על פי *acc. to* the mouth (i.e. command, [Gn 45:21](https://ref.ly/Gen45:21) \+ oft, evidence [Dt 17:6](https://ref.ly/Deut17:6), [19:15](https://ref.ly/Deut19:15), sentence [21:5](https://ref.ly/Deut21:5)) of…; …עַל שֵׁם *acc. to* the name of…(mostly with *call, be called*) [Gn 48:6](https://ref.ly/Gen48:6), [Ex 28:21](https://ref.ly/Exod28:21), [2 S 18:18](https://ref.ly/2Sam18:18) \+, cf. [1 Ch 23:14](https://ref.ly/1Chr23:14); [Ex 6:26](https://ref.ly/Exod6:26), [12:51](https://ref.ly/Exod12:51) עַל צִבְאֹתָם *acc. to* their hosts (usu. לְ), [Nu 1:18](https://ref.ly/Num1:18) על משׁפחתם (usu. לְ) v:[52](https://ref.ly/Num1:52), [2:2](https://ref.ly/Num2:2), [2:34](https://ref.ly/Num2:34), [7:3](https://ref.ly/Num7:3) (‖ל), [Dt 18:8](https://ref.ly/Deut18:8) (prob.); עַל יְדֵי *acc. to* the hands (direction) of [Je 5:31](https://ref.ly/Jer5:31), [33:13](https://ref.ly/Jer33:13) *al.* (v. p. 391 b); [Psalm 110:4](https://ref.ly/Ps110:4) ´עַל דִּבְרָתִי מ *after* the manner of M.; [Pr 25:11](https://ref.ly/Prov25:11) (prob.) a word spoken עַל אָעפנָיו *in accordance with* its circumstances \= appositely; of the tune *acc. to* which a song is to be sung (RV. *set* to) [Psalm 6:1](https://ref.ly/Ps6:1) ([1 Ch 15:21](https://ref.ly/1Chr15:21)), [8:1](https://ref.ly/Ps8:1), [9:1](https://ref.ly/Ps9:1), [12:1](https://ref.ly/Ps12:1), [45:1](https://ref.ly/Ps45:1), [46:1](https://ref.ly/Ps46:1) ([1 Ch 15:20](https://ref.ly/1Chr15:20)) עַל־עֲלָמוֺת (perh., however, *in the manner of*maidens \= for ‘sopranos’), [53:1](https://ref.ly/Ps53:1), [56:1](https://ref.ly/Ps56:1), [60:1](https://ref.ly/Ps60:1), [69:1](https://ref.ly/Ps69:1), [81:1](https://ref.ly/Ps81:1), [84:1](https://ref.ly/Ps84:1), [88:1](https://ref.ly/Ps88:1) (cf. in Syr. ܕ ܘܠܐ ܥܠ). (*b*) The basis being conceived as involving the *ground*, על denotes the cause or reason, *on account of, because of*, [Gn 20:3](https://ref.ly/Gen20:3) lo thou shalt die עַל הָאִשָּׁה *on account* of the woman, [21:12](https://ref.ly/Gen21:12), [26:7](https://ref.ly/Gen26:7), [26:9](https://ref.ly/Gen26:9), [27:41](https://ref.ly/Gen27:41), [42:21](https://ref.ly/Gen42:21), [Lv 4:3](https://ref.ly/Lev4:3), [4:28](https://ref.ly/Lev4:28), [5:18](https://ref.ly/Lev5:18), [19:17](https://ref.ly/Lev19:17), [26:18](https://ref.ly/Lev26:18), [26:24](https://ref.ly/Lev26:24), [26:28](https://ref.ly/Lev26:28), [Dt 9:18](https://ref.ly/Deut9:18), [24:16](https://ref.ly/Deut24:16) fathers shall not be put to death על־בנים *on account of* children, [31:18](https://ref.ly/Deut31:18), [Jos 9:20](https://ref.ly/Josh9:20), [Je 1:16](https://ref.ly/Jer1:16), [5:9](https://ref.ly/Jer5:9), Ez [18:26](https://ref.ly/Ezek18:26) עליהם(‖ [33:18](https://ref.ly/Ezek33:18) בָּהֶם), [Pr 28:21](https://ref.ly/Prov28:21), [Psalm 39:12](https://ref.ly/Ps39:12), [50:8](https://ref.ly/Ps50:8) \+ oft.; [Psalm 44:23](https://ref.ly/Ps44:23) עָלֶיְ הֹרַגְנוּ *on thy account* are we slain all the day, [69:8](https://ref.ly/Ps69:8), [Je 15:15](https://ref.ly/Jer15:15); in the phrases עַל…דְּבַר, עַל אוֺדוֺת, עַל זאֹת and עַל זֶה *on* this *account*, עַל מָה *on* what *account ?* עַל־כֵּן \= *therefore* (v. דָּבָר, אוֺדָה, etc.); before an inf., as [Ex 17:7](https://ref.ly/Exod17:7) ´וְעַל נַסּוֺתָם אֶת־י and *on, account of* their trying ´י, [Am 1:3](https://ref.ly/Amos1:3) עַל דּוּשָׁם *on account of* their threshing \= because they threshed, v:[6](https://ref.ly/Amos1:6), v:[9](https://ref.ly/Amos1:9), v:[11](https://ref.ly/Amos1:11), v:[13](https://ref.ly/Amos1:13), etc., [Je 2:35](https://ref.ly/Jer2:35) עַל אָמְרֵךְ *because of* thy saying, [9:12](https://ref.ly/Jer9:12), [16:18](https://ref.ly/Jer16:18) \+; and as a conj. both with and without אֲשֶׁר or כִּי (v. infr. **III**). And so often of the ground or cause of fear, grief, delight, or other emotions, e.g. [Ex 18:9](https://ref.ly/Exod18:9), [32:14](https://ref.ly/Exod32:14) (נִחַם *repent*: so oft.), [1 S 4:13](https://ref.ly/1Sam4:13), [30:6](https://ref.ly/1Sam30:6), [2 S 1:26](https://ref.ly/2Sam1:26), [3:8](https://ref.ly/2Sam3:8), [1 K 21:4](https://ref.ly/1Kgs21:4), [2 K 6:11](https://ref.ly/2Kgs6:11), [Je 10:19](https://ref.ly/Jer10:19), [Am 6:6](https://ref.ly/Amos6:6). (*c*) Somewhat more strongly, *on behalf of, for the sake of*, [Gn 19:17](https://ref.ly/Gen19:17) escape על נפשׁך *for*thy life; Ju [9:17](https://ref.ly/Judg9:17), [2 K 10:3](https://ref.ly/2Kgs10:3) נִלְחֵם עַל (usu. ל); [1 K 2:18](https://ref.ly/1Kgs2:18) I will speak *on thy behalf to* the king, v:[19](https://ref.ly/1Kgs2:19) ([2 K 4:13](https://ref.ly/2Kgs4:13) לְ); [Est 4:16](https://ref.ly/Esth4:16), [4:8](https://ref.ly/Esth4:8), [7:7](https://ref.ly/Esth7:7), [8:11](https://ref.ly/Esth8:11), [9:16](https://ref.ly/Esth9:16), [Dn 12:1](https://ref.ly/Dan12:1) על עמר stand up (in late Heb.) *on behalf of*; התפלל על intercede *for* (usu. בעד) [Jb 42:8](https://ref.ly/Job42:8), [Ne 1:6](https://ref.ly/Neh1:6), [2 Ch 30:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr30:18), [29:21](https://ref.ly/2Chr29:21), [Ezr 8:35](https://ref.ly/Ezra8:35); and very often with כִּפֶּר (q.v.) make atonement *for*. (Not very common with other verbs.) (*d*) Sometimes it acquires almost a final force, *for*; [Ex 12:4](https://ref.ly/Exod12:4), [29:36](https://ref.ly/Exod29:36), [30:16](https://ref.ly/Exod30:16), [Dt 27:13](https://ref.ly/Deut27:13) there shall stand עַל־הַקְּלָלָה (‖ v:[12](https://ref.ly/Deut27:12) לְבָרֵח), [Psalm 89:4](https://ref.ly/Ps89:4) עַל־מַה־שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל־עבּנֵי־אָדָם *unto* what vanity hast thou created, etc.! [Pr 29:5](https://ref.ly/Prov29:5) b, [2 Ch 23:18](https://ref.ly/2Chr23:18), [Ec 3:17](https://ref.ly/Eccl3:17). (*e*) Of a *condition*, or *attendant circumstances* (rare; so عَلَي, WAG ii § 59 e): [Psalm 50:5](https://ref.ly/Ps50:5) עֲלֵי :ָ\+זבַח *upon, with* sacrifice, [92:4](https://ref.ly/Ps92:4) ´עֲלי עָשוֺר וגו *with* a ten\-stringed instr., *with* a harp, *with* sounding music on a lyre ; עַל רִיב *upon occasion of* a law\-suit [Ex 23:2](https://ref.ly/Exod23:2), Ex 44:24, עַל יוֺם טוֺב [1 S 25:8](https://ref.ly/1Sam25:8) (cf. حِين عَلَي *at a time of*… Qor 28:14\), [Ne 12:22](https://ref.ly/Neh12:22) (? rd. עַד BeRy), [Is 18:4](https://ref.ly/Isa18:4) כְּחֹם חַח עֲלֵי אוֺר *at time* of sunshine, [64:11](https://ref.ly/Isa64:11) עַל אֵלֶּה, [Je 8:18](https://ref.ly/Jer8:18); עֲלֵי יָגוֺן *at time of* sorrow, [16:7](https://ref.ly/Jer16:7) (but Gie עַל אָבֵל *to*): with abstr. substs. to form a periphr. for adverbs, [Lv 5:22](https://ref.ly/Lev5:22) and swear עַל שֶׁקֶר *upon* falseness \= falsely, [Je 6:14](https://ref.ly/Jer6:14) \= [8:11](https://ref.ly/Jer8:11) to heal a wound עַל נְקַלָּה *lightly, easily*, [Psalm 31:24](https://ref.ly/Ps31:24) עַל יֶתֶר \= *abundantly*, [Is 60:7](https://ref.ly/Isa60:7) עַל רָצוֺן \= *acceptably* (cf. لَدَّةٍ عَلَ \= *with* delight). (*f* ) It hence acquires the force of *in spite of, notwithstanding* (so عَلَ, WAG ii. § 59 h), [Jb 10:7](https://ref.ly/Job10:7) עַל דַּעְתְּ *in spite of* thy knowing, [34:6](https://ref.ly/Job34:6) משׁפטי על *notwithstanding* my right I am to be a liar (Di De Da RV: otherwise Hi RVm). Cf. below, **III c** b. *(g)* *Upon, concerning*, with vbs. of speaking, as דִּבֶּר Ju [9:3](https://ref.ly/Judg9:3), [1 K 5:13](https://ref.ly/1Kgs5:13), אָמַר, [Je 16:3](https://ref.ly/Jer16:3), [27:19](https://ref.ly/Jer27:19) (‖אל) [33:4](https://ref.ly/Jer33:4), hearing [Gn 41:15](https://ref.ly/Gen41:15) שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיְ I have heard *concerning* thee, saying, etc., [1 K 10:6](https://ref.ly/1Kgs10:6), [Is 37:9](https://ref.ly/Isa37:9) (‖ [2 K 19:9](https://ref.ly/2Kgs19:9) אל), disputing [Gn 26:11](https://ref.ly/Gen26:11), telling [1 S 27:11](https://ref.ly/1Sam27:11), [Jo 1:3](https://ref.ly/Joel1:3), commanding [2 S 14:8](https://ref.ly/2Sam14:8), [1 K 11:10](https://ref.ly/1Kgs11:10), being vexed [21:4](https://ref.ly/1Kgs21:4), [2 K 6:11](https://ref.ly/2Kgs6:11), crying [8:5](https://ref.ly/2Kgs8:5), confessing [Psalm 32:5](https://ref.ly/Ps32:5), [Ne 1:6](https://ref.ly/Neh1:6); of the object of a prophecy or vision [1 K 22:8](https://ref.ly/1Kgs22:8), [Is 1:1](https://ref.ly/Isa1:1), [2:1](https://ref.ly/Isa2:1); and often with similar verbs. (*h*) In a somewhat weaker sense, *in the matter of, as regards*, [Gn 41:32](https://ref.ly/Gen41:32) וְעַל הִשָּׁנוֺת הַחֲלוֺם, [Ex 22:8](https://ref.ly/Exod22:8), [Ru 4:7](https://ref.ly/Ruth4:7), [Lv 5:22](https://ref.ly/Lev5:22), [5:26](https://ref.ly/Lev5:26), [Dn 9:14](https://ref.ly/Dan9:14) b, [Ne 9:33](https://ref.ly/Neh9:33); חָטָא עַל [Lv 4:14](https://ref.ly/Lev4:14) (‖בָּהּ v:[23](https://ref.ly/Lev4:23), cogn. acc. v:[28](https://ref.ly/Lev4:28)), [5:5](https://ref.ly/Lev5:5), [Nu 6:11](https://ref.ly/Num6:11), [Ne 13:26](https://ref.ly/Neh13:26); …עַל־דְּבַר *in the matter of*, [Nu 25:18](https://ref.ly/Num25:18), [31:16](https://ref.ly/Num31:16). **2\.** It expresses *excess* (synon. מִן q.v.); [Gn 48:22](https://ref.ly/Gen48:22) I give thee שְׁכֶם אַחַר עַל אַחֶיְ one shoulder (ridge) *above* thy brethren, [Ex 16:5](https://ref.ly/Exod16:5) מִשְׁנֶה על double *above* or *beyond*, [Nu 3:46](https://ref.ly/Num3:46), [Dt 25:3](https://ref.ly/Deut25:3) stripes עַל־אֵלֶּה *beyond* these, [Jos 3:15](https://ref.ly/Josh3:15) Jordan מָלֵא עַל was full *over* all its banks (cf. [4:18](https://ref.ly/Josh4:18), [Is 8:7](https://ref.ly/Isa8:7) b הלך על, עלה) [Psalm 138:2](https://ref.ly/Ps138:2), [Ec 1:16](https://ref.ly/Eccl1:16), [Dn 1:20](https://ref.ly/Dan1:20) עֶשֶר יָדוֺת עַל ten times *above* (cf. in Aram. [3:19](https://ref.ly/Dan3:19), and عَلَي Qor 37:153\), [Ezr 1:6](https://ref.ly/Ezra1:6) † לְבַר עַל \= *beside* (v. בַּר); [Psalm 16:2](https://ref.ly/Ps16:2) (si vera l.) טוֺבָתִי בַל עָלֶיְ my welfare is not *beyond* thee, i.e. does not lie outside thee.—Of time, [Lv 15:25](https://ref.ly/Lev15:25) if she has an issue עַל נִדָּתָהּ *beyond* her time of impurity (cf. [Is 32:10](https://ref.ly/Isa32:10), **4 b**). **3\.** It denotes *elevation* or *pre\-eminence*, as עליון על high (fig.) *above*, [Dt 26:19](https://ref.ly/Deut26:19) *al.*, [28:43](https://ref.ly/Deut28:43) יעלה עליך will go up *above* thee, cf. [Pr 31:29](https://ref.ly/Prov31:29); [Psalm 57:6](https://ref.ly/Ps57:6), [57:12](https://ref.ly/Ps57:11) be thou exalted *above* the heavens, [89:8](https://ref.ly/Ps89:8), [95:3](https://ref.ly/Ps95:3), [96:4](https://ref.ly/Ps96:4), etc., [Ne 9:5](https://ref.ly/Neh9:5); with words (q.v.) such as נכר, גדל, חזק, נשא (Ni. Pi. Hithp.), עזז, and esp. those denoting rule or superintendence, as מלך, הפקיד; so with שָׁת, היה, נתן, [Gn 41:33](https://ref.ly/Gen41:33), [41:40](https://ref.ly/Gen41:40), [41:43](https://ref.ly/Gen41:43) שם; [1 S 18:5](https://ref.ly/1Sam18:5); with פָּקִיר, שַר, מֶלֶךְ, etc., [Gn 41:34](https://ref.ly/Gen41:34), [Ex 1:11](https://ref.ly/Exod1:11), [18:21](https://ref.ly/Exod18:21), etc.; abs. (v. כַּיִת **6**); אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמַּם the overseer of the forced labour [1 K 12:18](https://ref.ly/1Kgs12:18); אשׁר על־העיר the governor of the city [2 K 10:5](https://ref.ly/2Kgs10:5), אשׁר על המלתחה v:[22](https://ref.ly/2Kgs10:22). **4\.** It expresses *addition* (cf. ἐπὶ in Gk., e.g. ἐπὶ τούτοις) ; viz. **a.** introducing the complement of a verb, as with יָסַף to add *upon* or *to*, [Psalm 61:7](https://ref.ly/Ps61:7) \+ oft. [60:5](https://ref.ly/Isa60:5)); also Hb [2:16](https://ref.ly/Hab2:16) תִּסֹּב כּוֺם עַל [La 4:21](https://ref.ly/Lam4:21), [Est 4:7](https://ref.ly/Esth4:7); נֶחְשַׁב to be reckoned *to* [Lv 25:31](https://ref.ly/Lev25:31), [2 S 4:2](https://ref.ly/2Sam4:2), היה על [Nu 36:12](https://ref.ly/Num36:12); [Psalm 69:28](https://ref.ly/Ps69:28) תְּנָה עָוֺן עַל עֲוֺנָם, [Is 56:8](https://ref.ly/Isa56:8) עוֺר אֲקַבֵּץ עָלָיו I will yet gather (others) *unto* him. **b.** Used absol., as [Gn 28:9](https://ref.ly/Gen28:9) he took Maḥalath עַל נָשָׁיו *in addition to* his (other) wives, [31:50](https://ref.ly/Gen31:50) (cf. אל [Lv 18:18](https://ref.ly/Lev18:18)), [Nu 31:8](https://ref.ly/Num31:8) עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם *in addition to* their slain (‖ [Jos 13:22](https://ref.ly/Josh13:22) אֶל), [Dt 23:14](https://ref.ly/Deut23:14), Ez [16:37](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:37), [16:43](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:43), [25:10](https://ref.ly/Ezek25:10); [Is 32:10](https://ref.ly/Isa32:10) יָמִים עַל שָׁנָה days *upon, in addition to*, a year, [2 Ch 31:15](https://ref.ly/2Chr31:15) יָמִים עַל יָמִים, Ez [7:26](https://ref.ly/Ezek7:26) הֹוָה עַל הֹוָה תָבוֺא (‖אל), [Je 4:20](https://ref.ly/Jer4:20) (if נִקְרָא \= *be proclaimed*), [Jb 16:14](https://ref.ly/Job16:14) יִפְרְצֵנִי פֶרֶץ עַל־פְּנֵי־פָרֶץ (cf. LagM iii. 112; also II. 14:130 ἕλκος ἐφ̓ ε{λκει, Odyss. 7:120 f; Qor 31:13\). So often in laws of P (cf. **c**), [Lv 7:12](https://ref.ly/Lev7:12) he shall offer עַל־זֶבַת הַתּוֺרָה *in addition to* the sacrifice of thanksgiving, etc., v:[13](https://ref.ly/Lev7:13) b, [Nu 6:20](https://ref.ly/Num6:20), [15:9](https://ref.ly/Num15:9), [28:10](https://ref.ly/Num28:10), [28:15](https://ref.ly/Num28:15), [28:24](https://ref.ly/Num28:24) (cf. מִלְּבַר v:[31](https://ref.ly/Num28:31), [29:6](https://ref.ly/Num29:6)), [35:6](https://ref.ly/Num35:6); Ez [16:43](https://ref.ly/Ezek16:43) (Hi Sm RV: cf. 44:7 אל). **c.** Hence by an easy transition it denotes *together with, with*, [Ex 35:22](https://ref.ly/Exod35:22) men *together with*(עַל) women, [Jb 38:32](https://ref.ly/Job38:32) וְעַיִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶיהָ תַנְחֵם and the Bear *with* her children, wilt thou lead them ? [1 K 15:20](https://ref.ly/1Kgs15:20), [Je 3:18](https://ref.ly/Jer3:18) the house of Isr. *with* the house of Judah, [Mi 5:2](https://ref.ly/Mic5:2) (Ca Ke Kue; but al. as **7 c** *a*), [Gn 32:12](https://ref.ly/Gen32:12) lest he come and smite me, אֵם עַל בָּנִים the mother *with* the children (cf. [Ex 23:18](https://ref.ly/Exod23:18), [34:25](https://ref.ly/Exod34:25)), v:[3](https://ref.ly/Deut16:3); in the phrase אכל על הדם to eat *with* the blood [1 S 14:32](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:32), [14:33](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:33) (v:[34](https://ref.ly/1Sam14:34) אל), [Lv 19:26](https://ref.ly/Lev19:26), Ez [33:25](https://ref.ly/Ezek33:25) (cf. in Gk. e.g. ἐπὶ τῷ σίτῳ πίνειν ὕδωρ); (*c*) Introducing the object *upon* which an action, or emotion, esp. if accompanied by a gesture, is conceived as being directed (but with some of these words, esp. when they refer to an *event*, rather than a person, as [Ex 18:9](https://ref.ly/Exod18:9), על is to be explained from **1 f** *b*). [Ec 5:15](https://ref.ly/Eccl5:15) always c. לְ, sf. לְעֻמָּתוֺ, once pl. cstr. לְעֻמּוֺת Ez [45:7](https://ref.ly/Ezek45:7); —**a.** *close by, side by side with:* [Ex 25:27](https://ref.ly/Exod25:27) ([37:14](https://ref.ly/Exod37:14)), [28:27](https://ref.ly/Exod28:27) ([39:20](https://ref.ly/Exod39:20)), [Lv 3:9](https://ref.ly/Lev3:9) לְעֻמַּת הֻעָצֶה יְסִירֶנָּה shall take it away *close by* the backbone; of movement in parallel lines, [2 S 16:13](https://ref.ly/2Sam16:13) Shimei was going along לְעֻמָּתוֺ *parallel with* him, v:[13](https://ref.ly/2Sam16:13), Ez [1:20](https://ref.ly/Ezek1:20) וְהָאוֺפַנִּים יִנָּֽשְאוּ לְעֻמָּתָם, v:[21](https://ref.ly/Ezek1:21), [3:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek3:13), [10:19](https://ref.ly/Ezek10:19), [11:22](https://ref.ly/Ezek11:22); [3:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek3:8) נָתַתִּי פָנֶיְ חֲזָקִים לְעֻמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם *by the side of* their face (which, as antagonism is implied, \= *against*, RV), v:[8](https://ref.ly/Ezek3:8). **b.** *agreeing with, corresponding to* (a common result of juxtaposition), [Ex 38:18](https://ref.ly/Exod38:18) a screen five cubits high לעמת קלעי החצר *agreeing with* (RV *answerable unto*) the hangings of the court (in height), Ez [40:18](https://ref.ly/Ezek40:18); prob. also [1 Ch 26:16](https://ref.ly/1Chr26:16), [Ne 12:24](https://ref.ly/Neh12:24) מִשְׁמָר ´מִשְׁמָר ל ward *corresponding to* ward. **c.** *correspondingly to*, [1 Ch 24:31](https://ref.ly/1Chr24:31) they also cast lots לְעֻמַּת אֲחֵיהֶם *correspondingly to* their brethren, vb the head, *correspondinly to* his younger brother, [26:12](https://ref.ly/1Chr26:12) to these…belonged charges *correspondingly to* (in common with) their brethren. **d.** before a sentence (Ges§ 155 n), [1 Ch 25:8](https://ref.ly/1Chr25:8) (strangely) לְעֻמַּת כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדוֺל (v. Ke) *correspondingly to* (the principle) *of* as the small so the great; [Ec 5:15](https://ref.ly/Eccl5:15) כָּל־עֻמַּת שֶׁכָּא *quite exactly as* he came, so shall he go (but LambertRÉJ xxxi. 47, RahlfsTh. Lt. \-z. 1896, 587 כִּלְעֻמַּת). **e.** מִלְּעֻמַּת (v. מִן **1 c, 9 a**) [1 K 7:20](https://ref.ly/1Kgs7:20) *close beside*.

## II עָמַם (id: BDB07183)

\[Str6004] † II. \[עָמַם] **vb.** darken, dim (NH *id.;* Ar. غَمَّ *cover, veil, conceal;* Targum עֲמַם *grow dark*);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 pl. sf. עֲמָמֻהוּ Ez [31:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek31:8) dub., but prob. (as Thes) cedars *did* not *eclipse him*; עֲמָמוְּ [28:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek28:3) no secret *do they hold dark* (\= is held dark) for thee (Ges§ 117 x). **Hoph.** *Impf.* 3 ms. יוּעַם זָהָב [La 4:1](https://ref.ly/Lam4:1) (fig.) *how is the gold dimmed !* cf. Bu.

## עָמַס (id: BDB07186)

\[Str6006] † \[עָמַס, ?עָמַש] **vb. 1\.** load. **2\.** carry a load (NH *id.;* Ph. עמס *carry;* cf. poss. Ar. عَمِسَ *gravis et obscurus fuit dies* (Frey));—**Qal** *Impf.* 3 ms. וַיַּעֲמֹס [Gn 44:13](https://ref.ly/Gen44:13), יַעֲמָ־ס [Psalm 68:20](https://ref.ly/Ps68:20); *Pt. act.* עֹמְסִים [Ne 13:15](https://ref.ly/Neh13:15); עֹמְשִים [4:11](https://ref.ly/Neh4:11) (but v. infr.); sf. עֹמְסֶיהָ [Zc 12:3](https://ref.ly/Zech12:3); *pass.* עֲמֻסִים [Is 46:3](https://ref.ly/Isa46:3), עֲמוּסוֺת v:[1](https://ref.ly/Isa46:1); —**1\.** *load* (obj. om.) upon (עַל) ass [Gn 44:13](https://ref.ly/Gen44:13) (E), [Ne 13:15](https://ref.ly/Neh13:15); so abs. [4:11](https://ref.ly/Neh4:11), lit., si vera l. (v. Be\-Ry Ryle); but rd. prob. חֲמֻשִׁים RyKau. **2\.** *carry a load* [Psalm 68:20](https://ref.ly/Ps68:20) (´י, for (ל) his people), *carry as a load* [Zc 12:3](https://ref.ly/Zech12:3) (fig.), pass. [Is 46:1](https://ref.ly/Isa46:1) (lit.), v:[3](https://ref.ly/Isa46:3) (fig.).

770:b. \[עָמַס etc.] ad fin.: add ‘**Hiph.** *Pf.* 3 ms. הֶעְמִיס [1 K 12:11](https://ref.ly/1Kgs12:11) *load* upon (acc. rei \+ עַל Pers.) \= [2 Ch 10:11](https://ref.ly/2Chr10:11).

> \[Str5986] † עָמוֺס **n.pr.m.** Amos the prophet;—[Am 1:1](https://ref.ly/Amos1:1), [7:8](https://ref.ly/Amos7:8), [7:10](https://ref.ly/Amos7:10), [7:11](https://ref.ly/Amos7:11), [7:12](https://ref.ly/Amos7:12), [7:14](https://ref.ly/Amos7:14), [8:2](https://ref.ly/Amos8:2), LXX Αμως.

> \[Str6007] † עֲמַסְיָה **n.pr.m.** name is Judah [2 Ch 17:16](https://ref.ly/2Chr17:16), LXX Μασαιας, LXXL Αμασιας (cf. Ph. אשמנעמס, בעלעמס CISi. 139, 169, 719, v. also GrayProp. N. 296 f.).

> \[Str4614] † מַעֲמָסָה **n.f.** load, burden;—´אֶבֶן מ [Zc 12:3](https://ref.ly/Zech12:3) *a stone of burden* \= heavy stone, hard to lift.

> \[Str6008] † עַמְעָד **n.pr.loc.** in Asher, [Jos 19:26](https://ref.ly/Josh19:26), LXX Αμιηλ, A Αμαδ, LXXL Αλφααδ.

> \[Str6045] † עִנְיָן **n.m.**:[Ec 1:13](https://ref.ly/Eccl1:13) occupation, task, only Ec (Aram. loan\-word LagBN 205; common in NH);—´ע abs. ## IV עָנָה (id: BDB07244)

\[Str6030] †IV. עָנָה **vb.** sing (Ar. غَنَّ *sing, chant*, غِنَآءٌ *singing, chanting*, etc.; Syr. ܥܰܢܺܝ *sing responsively*, ܥܽܘܢܺܝܬܳܐ *hymn, refrain;* poss. ## II עָנַן (id: BDB07259)

\[Str6049] †II. \[עָנַן] **vb. Pō‘.** practice soothsaying (prob. denom., but orig. meaning dub.; connex. with 1\. עָנָן (De1s 2, 6\) now gen. abandoned; LöwZMG xxxi (1877\), 539 cp. עַיִן *eye*, so WeSkizzen iii. 148 (but v. infr.); RSJPhil xiv (1885\), 119 f. cp. Ar. غُنَّةٌ *nasal twang, hum of insects*, whence diviners as *crooning;* Ew Gerber31 of diviner as interpreting *hum* of insects, *whisper* of leaves, etc.; WeHeid. 2, 204 now cp. عَنَّ *appear*, i. e. *dealers in phenomena*);—*Pf.* 3 ms. consec. וְעוֺנֵן [2 K 21:6](https://ref.ly/2Kgs21:6) \= [2 Ch 33:6](https://ref.ly/2Chr33:6); *Impf.* 2 mpl. וְלאֹ תְעוֵֺ\+ננוּ [Lv 19:26](https://ref.ly/Lev19:26) (H); *Pt.* as subst. מְעוֺנֵן [Dt 18:10](https://ref.ly/Deut18:10) (forbidden), pl. מְעֹנְנִים v:[14](https://ref.ly/Deut18:14), ´מְעוֺ [Mi 5:11](https://ref.ly/Mic5:11), אֵלוֺן מְעוֺנְנִים Ju [9:37](https://ref.ly/Judg9:37) (v. 1\. אֵלוֺן; seat of an oracle, cf. ## עצד (id: BDB07310)

עצד (√ of foll.; cf. Ar.عَضَدَ *lop trees with a* مِعْصَدٌ, a kind of *reaping\-hook;* Eth.ዐፀደ፡, ዐደድ፡ *reap*, ምኣዕዠድ፡, ምኣዕዠድ፡ *sickle;* NH מַעֲצָד *axe* (smaller than כַּשִּׁיל LevyNHWB ii. 423\).

> \[Str4621] † מַעֲצָד **n.\[m.]** axe;—[Je 10:3](https://ref.ly/Jer10:3); in [Is 44:12](https://ref.ly/Isa44:12) prob. del. (so Du CheHpt Skinner).

* **Associated Passages:** Jeremiah 10:3; Isaiah 44:12


## I עָצָה (id: BDB07312)

\[Str6095] †I. \[עָצָה] **vb.** shut (Ar. (و et ي) غَضَا IV. *shut eyes*; Eth. ዐጸወ፡ *shut* door);—**Qal** *Pt. act.* עֹצֶה עֵינָיו [Pr 16:30](https://ref.ly/Prov16:30) *he that shuts his eyes* (SS cp. עצּם \[[Is 29:10](https://ref.ly/Isa29:10)], which Gr reads).

\[Str6105,6095] † II. \[עָצַם] **vb.** shut the eyes (NH Hiph.; poss. connex. with Syr. ܥܡܰܨ \= *id.,* Ar. غَمَضَ, IV (on غَمُضَ \= ض v. NöZMG xxxii (1878\), 406\); NH עִמֵּץ *close eyes* of dead; cf. Baes 5f.);—**Qal** *Pt.* וְעֹצֵם עֵינָיו מִן [Is 33:15](https://ref.ly/Isa33:15) *shutteth his eyes from seeing* **Pi** *Impf.* 3 ms. וַיְעַצֵּם אֶת־עֵינֵיכֶם [Is 29:10](https://ref.ly/Isa29:10) *he hath tightly shut your eyes* (cf. I. עצה).

## III עצם (id: BDB07333)

\[Str6099] III. עצם (√ of foll., si vera l.; cf. Ar. عَصَمَ *defend, protect*, عِصْمَةٌ *defence*, v. Du and cf. Thes; \> De Di al. *your mighty things* strong arguments (fr. עָצוּם, sub I. עצם, which foll. perhaps imitates in vocalization)).

> \[Str6110,6099] † \[עֲצֻמָה] **n.f.** defence;—pl. sf. עֲצֻמוֺתֵיכֻם (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. ´עַצֻּמ) [Is 41:21](https://ref.ly/Isa41:21) *bring forward your defences,* defensive arguments (CheHpt עַצְּבוֺתֵיכֻם *your idols,* after Gr, \[so Lo Klo explain ´עצמ, as *mightiest* aid, I. עצם]).

## עקב (id: BDB07342)

עקב (√ of foll., meaning dub.: Thes assumes *be protuberant*, whence both עָקֵב *heel* and II. עָקֹב *hilly*).

> \[Str6119] †I. עָקֵב **n.m.** heel, footprint, hinderpart (Arab. عَقِبٌ *heel*, fig. *end* (of a month), عِقْبَةٌ *mark, sign, trace;* Aram. עִקְבָּא, ܥܩܶܒ *he3l, footprint*, fig. *trace, mark* (cf. Wsd [2:4](https://ref.ly/Wis2:4) SyrVer [Ecclus 13:26](https://ref.ly/Sir13:26) HCT SyrVer), also *end, extremity*);—´ע abs. [Gn 3:15](https://ref.ly/Gen3:15) \+, cstr. עֲקֵב [25:26](https://ref.ly/Gen25:26), pl. cstr. עִקָבֵי Ct [1:8](https://ref.ly/Song1:8), עִקְּבֵי [Gn 49:17](https://ref.ly/Gen49:17), Ju [5:22](https://ref.ly/Judg5:22), עִקְּבוֺת [Psalm 77:20](https://ref.ly/Ps77:20), [89:52](https://ref.ly/Ps89:52), etc.;—**a.** *heel*, of man, [Gn 25:26](https://ref.ly/Gen25:26) וְיָדוֺ אֹחֶזֶת בַּעֲקֵב אָחִיו, as obj. of attack from behind, [3:15](https://ref.ly/Gen3:15) וְאַתָּה תְּשׁוּפֶנּוּ עָקֵב, [Jb 18:9](https://ref.ly/Job18:9) פַּח ´יאֹחֵז בְּע, [Je 13:22](https://ref.ly/Jer13:22) נֶחְמְסוּ עֲקֵבָיִךְ are treated violently, i.e. are rudely exposed (‖נִגְלוּ שׁוּלַיִח); as instrument of attack, [Psalm 41:10](https://ref.ly/Ps41:10) ´הִגְדִּיל עָלַי עָ hath *made great the heel against me*, i.e. given me insidiously a great fall (fig. for taken some cruel advantage of me; cf. ὑποσκελίζω ); of an animal, [Gn 49:17](https://ref.ly/Gen49:17) הַנּשֵׁח עִקְּבֵי סוּם, Ju [5:22](https://ref.ly/Judg5:22) **b.** *mark of heel, footprint*, Ct [1:8](https://ref.ly/Song1:8) צְאִי־לָח בְּעִקְבֵי הַצּאֹן, [Psalm 56:7](https://ref.ly/Ps56:7) יִשְׁמְרוּ עֲקֵבַי they mark my *footprints*, i.e. watch me insidiously wherever I go [89:52](https://ref.ly/Ps89:52) אֲשֶׁר הֵֽרְפוּ עִקְּבוֺת מְשִׁיחְֶָ i.e. followed him mockingly, of ´י (fig.) [Psalm 77:20](https://ref.ly/Ps77:20) עִקְּבוֺתֶיְ לאֹ נוֺדָעוּ thy *footprints* were not known (the waters closing over them). **c** *hinder\-part, rear* (of a troop of men), [Gn 49:19](https://ref.ly/Gen49:19) :וְהוּא יָגוּב עָקֵב (rd. אָשֵׁר :עֲקֵבָם) he will troop on *their rear*, [Jos 8:13](https://ref.ly/Josh8:13) עֲקֵבָם (cf. Di).

> \[Str6117] † עָקַב **vb.** follow at the heel, fig. assail insidiously, circumvent, overreach (denom. from עָקֵב; cf. Ar. عَقَبَ *follow* (at the heel), *succeed*, III. *bring consequence on*, i.e. *punish*, Qor 22:59, IV. *make to follow*, i.e.  *reward* or *punish*, عَاقِبَةٌ *end, final lot* 6:11 *reward* 6:136 ܥܩܰܒ  *hold back* (rare), *follow*, Pa. *investigate, search out:* Eth. ዐቀበ፡ is *keep, guard*);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 ms. [Ho 12:4](https://ref.ly/Hos12:4) בַּבֶּטֶן עָקַב אֶת־אָחִיו he *attacked* his brother *at the heel* (cf. [Gn 25:26](https://ref.ly/Gen25:26) sub עָקֵב); *Impf.* 3 ms. [Gn 27:36](https://ref.ly/Gen27:36) הֲכִי קָרָא שְׁמוֺ יַעֲקֹב וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם and he hath *overreached* me now twice; \+ *Inf. abs* [Je 9:3](https://ref.ly/Jer9:3) בָּל־אָח עָקוֺב יַעֲקֹב surely *overreacheth* (‖רָכִיל יַהֲלֽח). \[LXX πτερνίζω, to attack *with* the heel; but this dub. In ‘supplant,\&rs. also, the fig. is a different one.] **Pi.** [Jb 37:4](https://ref.ly/Job37:4) וְלאֹ יְעַקְּבֵם dub.; poss *attack at the heel* (cf. זִנֵּב), hence fig. *hold back;* more prob. rd. וְלאֹ יְעַכְּבֵם *holdeth* them not *back* (sc. בְּרָקָיו his lightnings), when his voice is heard from עִכֵּב *to hold back* (common in NH; Targum עַכֵּב).

## II עָשָה (id: BDB07477)

\[Str6213] † II. \[עָשָה] **vb. Pi** press, squeeze (NH עִשָּה Pi. *compel;* Targum עַסִּי Pa. *crush, gnash* (teeth); cf. Ar. غَشِىَ *compress* a woman);—*Pf.* 3 pl. עִשּוּ דַּדֵּי בְּתוּלִים Ez [23:3](https://ref.ly/Ezek23:3), [23:8](https://ref.ly/Ezek23:8) (unchaste act); *Inf. cstr.* דַּדַּיִךְ…בַּעֲשוֺת v:[21](https://ref.ly/Ezek23:21) rd. Pi. בְּעַשּוֺת (Ew Co Toy, al.).

> \[Str6215] עֵשָו:97 **n.pr.m. Esau**, Ησαυ;—*Esau*, elder son of Isaac [Gn 25:25](https://ref.ly/Gen25:25), [25:26](https://ref.ly/Gen25:26) \+ 7 t. 25, [26:34](https://ref.ly/Gen26:34), [27:1](https://ref.ly/Gen27:1) \+ 24 t. 27, 28, [32:4](https://ref.ly/Gen32:4) \+ 15 t. 32, 33, 35, [Jos 24:4](https://ref.ly/Josh24:4), [24:4](https://ref.ly/Josh24:4), [Mal 1:2](https://ref.ly/Mal1:2), [1:3](https://ref.ly/Mal1:3), [1 Ch 1:34](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:34); identif. with אֱדוֺם [Gn 36:1](https://ref.ly/Gen36:1), [36:8](https://ref.ly/Gen36:8), [36:19](https://ref.ly/Gen36:19), ancestor of Edomites v:[9](https://ref.ly/Gen36:9); v:[43](https://ref.ly/Gen36:43), cf. [1 Ch 1:35](https://ref.ly/1Chr1:35); dwelling in Mt. Seir [Gn 36:8](https://ref.ly/Gen36:8) (25 t. in all, Gn 36) [Dt 2:5](https://ref.ly/Deut2:5), [Jos 24:4](https://ref.ly/Josh24:4); בְּנֵי עֵשָו \= Edomites [Dt 2:4](https://ref.ly/Deut2:4), [2:8](https://ref.ly/Deut2:8), [2:12](https://ref.ly/Deut2:12), [2:22](https://ref.ly/Deut2:22), [2:29](https://ref.ly/Deut2:29); עֵשָו \= Edom [Je 49:8](https://ref.ly/Jer49:8), Ob:[6](https://ref.ly/Obad1:6), בֵּית עֵשָו v:[18](https://ref.ly/Obad1:18), v:[18](https://ref.ly/Obad1:18), הַר עֵשָו v:[18](https://ref.ly/Obad1:18), v:[9](https://ref.ly/Obad1:9), v:[19](https://ref.ly/Obad1:19), v:[21](https://ref.ly/Obad1:21).

## עָשַק (id: BDB07479)

Ar. عَشِقَ *cling* with love (LagBN 143\); Syr. ܥܣܰܩ, Ethpa. *be difficult* (i.e. *indignant, hostile*); NH עָסַק, Targum עֲסַק, *busy oneself*, NH עֵסֶק *business, occupation*);—*Pf.* 3 pl. הִתְעַשְּקוּ עִמּוֺ [Gn 26:20](https://ref.ly/Gen26:20) *they contended with him*.

## עתל (id: BDB07529)

עתל (√ of foll.; perh. \= As. *atâlu, grow great,* cf. *etellu, great, exalted*; so CheExpos. Times, vii. 484, 568; viii. 48\).

> \[Str6270–71] † (וּ)עֲתַלְיָ֫ה, עַתְלָי **n.pr.f.** et **m.** (? ´י *is exalted*);—**1\. f.** Athaliah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, mother of Ahaziah king of Judah; Γοθολια: יָהוּ\- [2 K 8:26](https://ref.ly/2Kgs8:26), [11:2](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:2), [11:20](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:20) \= [2 Ch 22:2](https://ref.ly/2Chr22:2), [22:10](https://ref.ly/2Chr22:10), [22:11](https://ref.ly/2Chr22:11), [23:12](https://ref.ly/2Chr23:12), [23:13](https://ref.ly/2Chr23:13), [23:21](https://ref.ly/2Chr23:21), [24:7](https://ref.ly/2Chr24:7); יָה\- [2 K 11:1](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:1), [11:3](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:3), [11:13](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:13), [11:14](https://ref.ly/2Kgs11:14), [2 Ch 22:12](https://ref.ly/2Chr22:12). **2\. m. a.** [1 Ch 8:26](https://ref.ly/1Chr8:26) Ογοθολια. **b.** [Ezr 8:7](https://ref.ly/Ezra8:7) Αθελει, A Αθλια; LXXL Γοθονίου (genit.). **c.** עַתְלָי one with foreign wife [Ezr 10:28](https://ref.ly/Ezra10:28), Θαλι, A Οθαλι.

* **Associated Passages:** 2 Chronicles 22:12; 2 Kings 11:13; Ezra 8:7; 2 Chronicles 23:12; 1 Chronicles 8:26; 2 Kings 11:2; 2 Chronicles 22:2; 2 Chronicles 22:10; 2 Chronicles 24:7; Ezra 10:28; 2 Chronicles 23:13; 2 Chronicles 23:21; 2 Kings 11:20; 2 Kings 11:1; 2 Kings 8:26; 2 Chronicles 22:11; 2 Kings 11:3; 2 Kings 11:14


## עָתַם (id: BDB07531)

\[Str6272] † \[עָתַם] **vb.** dub.; **Niph.** *Pf.* 3 ms. נֶעְתַּם אָרֶץ [Is 9:18](https://ref.ly/Isa9:18) (غَتَمَ *is be clogged in speech,* غَتْمٌ *suffocating heat,* مَغْتُومٌ *burned by heat;* hence Thes *scorched,* but derived sense dub.; v. RSJPhil. xiii. 61 f.);—read perhaps נִצְּתָה (√ יָצַת) *is burned up,* cf. RSl. c., Krochm Kit CheHpt.

> \[Str6273] † עָתְנִי **n.pr.m** Levite [1 Ch 26:7](https://ref.ly/1Chr26:7), Γοονει, (Γ)οθνι.

> \[Str6274] † עָתְנִיאֵל **n.pr.m.** son of Ḳenaz, a hero in Isr., Γοθονιηλ, [Jos 15:17](https://ref.ly/Josh15:17), Ju [1:13](https://ref.ly/Judg1:13), [3:9](https://ref.ly/Judg3:9), [3:11](https://ref.ly/Judg3:11), [1 Ch 4:13](https://ref.ly/1Chr4:13), [4:13](https://ref.ly/1Chr4:13); name of family [27:15](https://ref.ly/1Chr27:15).

* **Associated Passages:** Judges 3:11; Judges 3:9; Joshua 15:17; Isaiah 9:18; Judges 1:13; 1 Chronicles 26:7; 1 Chronicles 4:13; 1 Chronicles 27:15


## עָתֵק (id: BDB07534)

\[Str6275] † \[עָתֵק] **vb.** move, proceed, advance (NH Hiph.; As. *etêku* as H., also trans. *bring, move;* Ar. عَتَقَ, عَتُقَ *precede, pass forth, become free, grow old;* Aram. ܥܬܶܩ, עֲתַק *grow old,* Palm. adj. עתק *old*);—**Qal** *Pf.* 3 fs. עָֽתְקָה [Psalm 6:8](https://ref.ly/Ps6:8), 3 pl. עָֽתְקוּ [Jb 21:7](https://ref.ly/Job21:7); *Impf.* 3 ms. יֶעְתַּק [Jb 14:18](https://ref.ly/Job14:18), [18:4](https://ref.ly/Job18:4); —**l.** *move* מִמְּקֹמוֺ ´וְצוּר יֶע [Jb 14:18](https://ref.ly/Job14:18), so [18:4](https://ref.ly/Job18:4). **2\.** *advance* (in years; Aramaic sense) [21:7](https://ref.ly/Job21:7) (‖יִחְיוּ); hence \= grow old and weak [Psalm 6:8](https://ref.ly/Ps6:8) (of eye, ‖עָֽשְׁשָׁה). **Hiph.** *Pf.* 3 pl. הֶעְתִּיקוּ [Jb 32:16](https://ref.ly/Job32:16) (Gi; van d. H. Baer v15), [Pr 25:1](https://ref.ly/Prov25:1); *Impf.* 3 ms. וַיַּעְתֵּק [Gn 12:8](https://ref.ly/Gen12:8), [26:22](https://ref.ly/Gen26:22); *Pt.* מַעְתִּיק [Jb 9:5](https://ref.ly/Job9:5); —**1\.** *move forward* (sc. tent) \= proceed [Gn 12:8](https://ref.ly/Gen12:8) (מִשָּׁם, ה loc.), [26:22](https://ref.ly/Gen26:22) (מִשָּׁם); so fig. [Jb 32:16](https://ref.ly/Job32:16) (v. supr.) words *have moved away* from them (מֵהֶם), but v. prob. gloss (Bu al.). **2\.** [Jb 9:5](https://ref.ly/Job9:5) *he who removeth mountains*. **3\.** very late [Pr 25:1](https://ref.ly/Prov25:1) *transcribe* (*remove* from one book or roll to another; LXX ἐξεγράψαντο, Vulgate *transtulerunt;* so in mediaeval Heb.: ZunzZMG xxv (1871\), 447 f. \= Ges. Schr. iii. 66 f.).

> \[Str6277] † עָתָק **adj.** forward, arrogant (of speech) (Thes *free* (v. Ar.), *unrestrained*);—[1 S 2:3](https://ref.ly/1Sam2:3), [Psalm 31:19](https://ref.ly/Ps31:19), [94:4](https://ref.ly/Ps94:4); so also [75:6](https://ref.ly/Ps75:6) (cf. צַוָּאר).

> \[Str6276] †עָתֵק **adj.** Thes (*ancient* and so) valuable; \< advanced, eminent, surpassing (cf. عتيق *preceding,* hence *surpassing, choice* Lane1947);—´הוֺן ע [Pr 8:18](https://ref.ly/Prov8:18) *eminent wealth*.

> \[Str6266] † עָתִיק **adj.** eminent, surpassing, choice (v. עָתֵק);—´מְכַסֶּה ע [Is 23:18](https://ref.ly/Isa23:18) *choice attire.*

> \[Str6267] † \[עַתִּיק] **adj.** removed, old;—**1\.** *removed,* עַתִּיקֵי מִשָּׁדָיִם [Is 28:9](https://ref.ly/Isa28:9) i.e. weaned (‖גְּמוּלֵי מֵחָלָד; on cstr. v. Ges§ 130 a). **2\.** *old, ancient* (Aramaism: עַתִּיק, ܥܰܬܻܝܩ, *old*), הַדְּדָרִים עַתִּיקִים [1 Ch 4:22](https://ref.ly/1Chr4:22).

* **Associated Passages:** Proverbs 8:18; Psalms 75:6; Psalms 94:4; Psalms 6:8; Isaiah 23:18; Job 9:5; Job 14:18; 1 Chronicles 4:22; Isaiah 28:9; Job 32:16; Genesis 12:8; Genesis 26:22; Proverbs 25:1; 1 Samuel 2:3; Psalms 31:19; Job 21:7; Job 18:4
* **Associated Articles:** עָתֵק (ID: `BDB07534@BDBHebrewLexicon`)


## I עָתַר (id: BDB07539)

\[Str6279] † I. \[עָתַר] **vb.** pray, supplicafe (always to God) (cf. Ar. عَتَرَ *slaughter for sacrifice* DeGn (4\) 381 We: Skizzen iii. 115, 166; Heid. (2\). 118, 142; RS Sem i. 210 f.; 2nd ed.; 227 f.);—**Qal** *Impf.* 3 ms. ´וַיֶעְתַּר לי [Gn 25:21](https://ref.ly/Gen25:21), ´אֶל־י [Ex 8:26](https://ref.ly/Exod8:26), [10:18](https://ref.ly/Exod10:18), Ju [13:8](https://ref.ly/Judg13:8); יֶעְתַּד אֶל־אֱלוֺהַּ [Jb 33:26](https://ref.ly/Job33:26). **Niph.** *be supplicated, entreated* (and grant entreaty; always of God), usu. c. ל of worshipper (v. ל **5 d**): *Pf.* 3 ms. consec. וְנֶעְתַּר לָהֶם [Is 19:22](https://ref.ly/Isa19:22); *Impf.* 3 ms. וַיֵּעָ֫תֶר לוֺ [Gn 25:21](https://ref.ly/Gen25:21), [2 Ch 33:13](https://ref.ly/2Chr33:13), וַיֵּעָתֵר לָנוּ [Ezr 8:23](https://ref.ly/Ezra8:23); c. לָאָרֶץ *for the land* [2 S 21:14](https://ref.ly/2Sam21:14), [24:25](https://ref.ly/2Sam24:25); *Inf. abs.* לָהֶם וְנַעְתּוֺר [1 Ch 5:20](https://ref.ly/1Chr5:20); cstr. (as subst.) הֵעָתֶר־לוֺ [2 Ch 33:19](https://ref.ly/2Chr33:19). **Hiph.** \= **Qal,** *make supplication,* c. אֶל, לְ: *Pf.* ´וְהַעְתַּרְתִּ֫י אֶל־י [Ex 8:25](https://ref.ly/Exod8:25); *Impf.* 2 ms. תַּעְתִּיר אֵלָיו [Jb 22:27](https://ref.ly/Job22:27); *Imv.* mpl. ´הַעְתִּירוּ אֶל־י [Ex 8:4](https://ref.ly/Exod8:4), [9:28](https://ref.ly/Exod9:28), ´לי [10:17](https://ref.ly/Exod10:17); also c. ל Pers. *in behalf of* whom, *Impf.* 1 S. אַעְתִּיר לְ [Ex 8:5](https://ref.ly/Exod8:5), so *Imv.* חַעְתִּירוּ, c. בַּעֲדִי v:[24](https://ref.ly/Exod8:24).

> \[Str6282] † I. \[עָתַר] **n.\[m.]** suppliant, worshipper (?; so usu., but dub.);—only pl. sf. עֲתָרַי [Zp 3:10](https://ref.ly/Zeph3:10).

* **Associated Passages:** Ezra 8:23; Exodus 9:28; Job 33:26; Exodus 8:5; 2 Chronicles 33:19; Exodus 8:25; Isaiah 19:22; 2 Samuel 24:25; Judges 13:8; Exodus 8:26; Genesis 25:21; Exodus 8:24; 2 Samuel 21:14; Exodus 10:17; Zephaniah 3:10; 1 Chronicles 5:20; 2 Chronicles 33:13; Exodus 8:4; Exodus 10:18; Job 22:27

## II עָתַר (id: BDB07541)

\[Str6280] II. \[עָתַר] **vb.** be abundant, si Vera l. (as Aram. loan\-word; עֲתַר, ܥܬܰܪ, *be rich* \= Heb. עָשַׁר);—**Niph.** *Pt.* fpl. נַעְתָּרוֺת [Pr 27:6](https://ref.ly/Prov27:6) (of enemy's kisses; De *excessive;* opp. נֶאֱמָנִים); Toy prop. נֶעֱקָשׁוֺת, or נַעֲוֺת, *crooked, hypocritical*. **Hiph.** *Pf.* 2 mpl. הַעְתַּרְתֶּם עָלַי דִּבְרֵיכֶם Ez [35:13](https://ref.ly/Ezek35:13) *ye have multiplied against me your words* (‖עָלַי בְּפִיכֶם וַתַּגְדִּילוּ), del. as gloss Co after LXX, Toy reads sg., and thinks verb due to Aramaizing scribe.

> \[Str6283] † עֲתֶ֫רֶת **n.f.** abundance (Aramaism, si vera l.);—cstr. [Je 33:6](https://ref.ly/Jer33:6) I will reveal to them *abundance* of peace, etc. (corrupt acc. to Gie BuhlLex; Vrss. render variously).

> \[Str6281,6269] † עֶ֫תֶר **n.pr.loc** (√ dub.);—in Judah [Jos 15:42](https://ref.ly/Josh15:42) ( Ιθακ; A LXXL Αθερ), in Simeon [19:7](https://ref.ly/Josh19:7) (Ιεθερ; in both sq. עָשָׁן); perhaps \= עֲתָח q.v.; perhaps (ConderSurvey iii. 261\) *‘Atr,* c. 2 miles NW. of *Beit Jibrin* (cf. GASmGeogr., Map).

* **Associated Passages:** Jeremiah 33:6; Joshua 15:42; Ezekiel 35:13; Joshua 19:7; Proverbs 27:6
